newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, losses among blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, losses among blue chips.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed mixed on Thursday with some losses in blue chips while selected hotelier issues continued to climb.
* Six of 13 active stocks up, six down, one traded for the first time
* Volume slightly higher at 14,814, turnover 9.1 million kuna. Exchange rate: 5.4433 kuna = $1
* Biggest loser fully-listed Pliva, down 500 kuna to 12,500 with 54 shares sold
* Suncani Hvar top gainer, up 35 kuna to 115 on volume of 3,461
* Most actively traded blue chip Zagrebacka Banka, down one kuna after mixed trade, closing at 999 kuna on volume of 6,181
* In a first deal with only one share, Varazdinska Banka first issue traded at 16,000 kuna. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
